title.sl: Primernik in presežnik: bigger, the biggest
title.de: Komparativ und Superlativ: bigger, the biggest
title.it: Comparativo e superlativo: bigger, the biggest
title.en: Comparatives and superlatives: bigger, the biggest

rule.sl:
Kratke besede dobijo **-er** in **the -est**: **old, older, the oldest** (star, starejši, najstarejši). Za dve stvari **-er** + **than** (kot, od): **Jack is younger than Sam.** (Jack je mlajši od Sama.) Za tri ali več **the -est** z **in** ali **of**: **Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village.**

Končni **-e** dobi **-r**, **-st** (**nicer, the nicest**); en samoglasnik + en soglasnik se podvoji (**bigger, the biggest**); soglasnik + **-y** postane **-ier**, **-iest** (**happier, the happiest**).

Dolge besede dobijo **more** in **the most**: **more useful, the most useful** (bolj koristen, najbolj koristen). Nikoli obojega: *more bigger*, *the most biggest*. Nekatere gredo na oba načina: **quieter** ali **more quiet**.

Posebne: **good, better, the best** (dober); **bad, worse, the worst** (slab); **far, further, the furthest** (daleč; tudi **farther, the farthest**).

Za **than**: samostalnik, **me**, **than I am**: **Sam is taller than me.** Koliko: **much bigger**, **a bit older**, nikoli *very bigger*.

**the** ostane, a ne za svojilnim zaimkom: **my best friend**. **in** s krajem ali skupino (**in the village**), **of** s številom (**of the three**).
rule.de:
Kurze Wörter bekommen **-er** und **the -est**: **old, older, the oldest** (alt, älter, der älteste). Bei zweien **-er** + **than** (als): **Jack is younger than Sam.** Bei dreien oder mehr **the -est** mit **in** oder **of**: **Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village.**

Ein **-e** am Ende bekommt **-r**, **-st** (**nicer, the nicest**); ein Vokal + ein Konsonant wird verdoppelt (**bigger, the biggest**); Konsonant + **-y** wird zu **-ier**, **-iest** (**happier, the happiest**).

Lange Wörter bekommen **more** und **the most**: **more useful, the most useful** (nützlicher, am nützlichsten). Nie beides: *more bigger*, *the most biggest*. Manche gehen beides: **quieter** oder **more quiet**.

Eigen: **good, better, the best** (gut); **bad, worse, the worst** (schlecht); **far, further, the furthest** (weit; auch **farther, the farthest**).

**than** heißt als, nie *as*. Danach ein Nomen, **me**, **than I am**: **Sam is taller than me.** Wie viel: **much bigger**, **a bit older**, nie *very bigger*.

**the** bleibt, aber nicht nach einem Possessiv: **my best friend**. **in** bei einem Ort oder einer Gruppe (**in the village**), **of** bei einer Zahl (**of the three**).
rule.it:
Le parole brevi prendono **-er** e **the -est**: **old, older, the oldest** (vecchio, più vecchio, il più vecchio). Tra due cose **-er** + **than** (di, che): **Jack is younger than Sam.** Tra tre o più **the -est** con **in** o **of**: **Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village.**

Una **-e** finale prende **-r**, **-st** (**nicer, the nicest**); una vocale + una consonante raddoppia (**bigger, the biggest**); consonante + **-y** diventa **-ier**, **-iest** (**happier, the happiest**).

Le parole lunghe prendono **more** e **the most**: **more useful, the most useful** (più utile, il più utile). Mai tutti e due: *more bigger*, *the most biggest*. Alcune vanno nei due modi: **quieter** o **more quiet**.

A parte: **good, better, the best** (buono); **bad, worse, the worst** (cattivo); **far, further, the furthest** (lontano; anche **farther, the farthest**).

Dopo **than**: un nome, **me**, **than I am**: **Sam is taller than me.** Di quanto: **much bigger**, **a bit older**, mai *very bigger*.

**the** resta, ma non dopo un possessivo: **my best friend**. **in** con un luogo o un gruppo (**in the village**, mai *of the village*), **of** con un numero (**of the three**).
rule.en:
Short words take **-er** and **the -est**: **old, older, the oldest**. For two things **-er** + **than**: **Jack is younger than Sam.** For three or more **the -est** with **in** or **of**: **Old Wilf is the oldest man in the village.**

A final **-e** takes **-r**, **-st** (**nicer, the nicest**); one vowel + one consonant doubles (**bigger, the biggest**); a consonant + **-y** becomes **-ier**, **-iest** (**happier, the happiest**).

Long words take **more** and **the most**: **more useful, the most useful**. Never both: **bigger** (never *more bigger*), **the biggest** (never *the most biggest*). Some go either way: **quieter** or **more quiet**.

Three stand alone: **good, better, the best**; **bad, worse, the worst**; **far, further, the furthest** (**farther, the farthest** too).

After **than**: a noun, **me**, **than I am**: **Sam is taller than me.** How much: **much bigger**, **a bit older** (never *very bigger*).

**the** stays, but not after a possessive: **my best friend**. **in** with a place or a group (**in the village**), **of** with a number (**of the three**).

rule.en: Short: **older than**, **the oldest**; long: **more useful than**, **the most useful**. Spelling: **bigger**, **nicer**, **happier**. On their own: **better, the best**; **worse, the worst**; **further, the furthest**.

tip.sl: 💡 Nikoli obojega: **bigger**, nikoli *more bigger*; **od** je **than**, nikoli *from*.
tip.it: 💡 Nel paese: **in the village**, mai *of the village*. Mai *more bigger*.
tip.en: 💡 Never both: **bigger** (never *more bigger*), **the best** (never *the most best*).
